decisions: Adopt all specified descriptive paired-reporting decisions for the6460exploratory design. No retrospective significance claim, silent method pruning, or validation-to-confirmation promotion. Later confirmation remains separate.
TEST_authorization_clarification: No campaign or TEST scoring is currently authorized. A future human GO may authorize training and the frozen final evaluation together. If that GO already includes final evaluation, the exact machine evaluation request and checkpoint receipts implement it; another human approval is not required merely because checkpoints became available. Otherwise ask for the missing authorization with a concrete reviewable request.
exposure_clarification: Closed TEST scoring does not mean public processed dataset files contain no TEST records. Role-scoped TRAIN/VALID use and actual outcome inspection are distinguished from ordinary loading of public archives. Unknown historical exposure remains unknown.
